CustomField.label: Approver 5
CustomField.description:
★R9 Level 5 of the approval chain, and the last one this metadata pre-provisions. Unused at the shipped configuration — see Approver_4__c for why it exists anyway.
Five is a starting point, not a platform limit that was measured: Salesforce caps the number of steps per approval process, and that cap has never been checked against a real org from this repo. Confirm it before anyone plans a chain longer than this.
